title: Implement V4 packaging, isolation and documentation lifecycle
goal: Complete deterministic versioned distribution, isolated verified installation, declared prerequisite validation, schema-generated documentation and reversible lifecycle without publishing or activating V4.
acceptanceCriteria: Identical immutable package and host inputs produce byte-identical versioned archives with source provenance and exact SHA-256 manifests.
Install, uninstall and reinstall are confined to an explicit clean root and fail closed on archive, receipt, path or installed-file drift.
The installed entry point validates package and selected-module runtime prerequisites before starting the V4 host and reports missing requirements structurally.
Command and configuration documentation is generated deterministically from authoritative JSON contracts and schemas.
A packaged host runs and resets an external synthetic target under hostile parent configuration without IFX or repository-parent influence.
Current V3 behavior remains unchanged and no release, active workflow, ruleset, push or other remote mutation occurs.
